value.rationale: The parameter is a standard domination/alliance invariant with established complexity and extremal literature, and complete multipartite graphs are a canonical structured family already represented by exact complete-bipartite special cases. The theorem upgrades those isolated special cases to a natural complete classification for arbitrary part counts and all positive \(k\), including an exact coefficient distribution of all feasible sets. This is a substantive structural description rather than a routine recomputation of one known minimum.
